source.name: CPIC / ClinPGx guideline library
source.release_note: The v1.61.0 release is dated 2026-10-26 and provides a full database export. The previous v1.60.1 release was an application-only API fix without a database image.
source.attribution: CPIC requests attribution and current-source verification. CPIC curated content is made available under CC0 1.0; database/API access is additionally subject to the ClinPGx data usage policy.
source.snapshot_basis: The app stores a curated, static subset of guideline records. This version metadata identifies the latest observed upstream CPIC data release; it does not claim the local subset was generated directly from the database dump.

interpretation_policy: Guideline association is mapped at the gene–drug pair level, not as a variant-specific recommendation.
A raw rsID call is not a CPIC diplotype, metabolizer phenotype, or clinical test result.
The presence of a guideline link does not establish that a particular uploaded marker is sufficient for guideline interpretation.
Some guidelines evaluate genes for which no actionable recommendation is available; that status must remain explicit.
Read the current guideline and its updates before using any CPIC data in a clinical or research setting.

guidelines.title: CYP2C19 and Clopidogrel
guidelines.summary: CPIC guidance describes how clinically determined CYP2C19 phenotypes can inform clopidogrel therapy. CYP2C19 is involved in bioactivation of this prodrug.

gene_pairs.scope_note: The guideline uses a clinically interpreted CYP2C19 phenotype. One rsID call in a consumer file is not enough to assign that phenotype.

guidelines.title: CYP2C19 and Proton Pump Inhibitor Dosing
guidelines.display_title: CYP2C19 and proton pump inhibitors (2021 publication)
guidelines.summary: CPIC provides CYP2C19 genotype-based guidance for selected proton pump inhibitors. The clinical context and duration of therapy matter.

gene_pairs.scope_note: The guideline considers clinically determined CYP2C19 phenotypes; it does not define a phenotype from a single raw SNP.

guidelines.title: CYP2D6, CYP2C19, CYP2B6, SLC6A4, HTR2A and Serotonin Reuptake Inhibitor Antidepressants
guidelines.summary: The guideline provides drug-specific recommendations for CYP2D6, CYP2C19 and CYP2B6. It describes evidence for SLC6A4 and HTR2A but does not support their clinical use for antidepressant prescribing.

gene_pairs.status_label: CPIC actionable recommendations available for selected drugs
gene_pairs.scope_note: The recommendation is drug- and phenotype-specific; this marker-only prototype does not assign the required CYP2D6 phenotype.

gene_pairs.status_label: CPIC actionable recommendations available for selected drugs
gene_pairs.scope_note: The recommendation is drug- and phenotype-specific; this marker-only prototype does not assign the required CYP2C19 phenotype.

gene_pairs.status_label: CPIC actionable recommendations available for selected drugs
gene_pairs.scope_note: This gene is included in the guideline even though it is not part of the prototype marker panel.
The guideline reports insufficient/mixed evidence to support clinical use of SLC6A4 for antidepressant prescribing.
The guideline reports insufficient/mixed evidence to support clinical use of HTR2A for antidepressant prescribing.

guidelines.title: CYP3A5 and Tacrolimus
guidelines.summary: CPIC guidance covers the use of clinically interpreted CYP3A5 genotype results in tacrolimus dosing, alongside therapeutic drug monitoring.

gene_pairs.scope_note: The guideline uses CYP3A5 diplotypes/phenotypes. This raw single-marker view does not determine expression status or a diplotype.

guidelines.title: SLCO1B1, ABCG2, CYP2C9 and Statins
guidelines.summary: CPIC provides statin recommendations using SLCO1B1, ABCG2 and CYP2C9. The guideline also evaluates other genes; not every evaluated gene has an actionable recommendation.

gene_pairs.status_label: CPIC actionable recommendations available for selected statins
gene_pairs.scope_note: The c.521T>C marker appears in multiple SLCO1B1 haplotypes. A single rsID does not uniquely identify a star allele or transporter phenotype.

gene_pairs.status_label: CPIC actionable recommendations available for rosuvastatin
gene_pairs.scope_note: This gene is part of the guideline but is not included in the prototype marker panel.

guidelines.title: CYP2C9, VKORC1, CYP4F2 and Warfarin
guidelines.summary: The CPIC warfarin guideline uses multiple genetic factors, including VKORC1, CYP2C9 and CYP4F2, with ancestry-related considerations and clinical information.

gene_pairs.status_label: Part of a multi-gene CPIC dosing guideline
gene_pairs.scope_note: VKORC1 is interpreted together with CYP2C9, CYP4F2 and additional clinical factors. This app does not calculate a dose or replace INR monitoring.

gene_pairs.status_label: Part of a multi-gene CPIC dosing guideline
gene_pairs.scope_note: The warfarin guideline considers multiple alleles and other genes; one marker is not enough to reproduce its dosing algorithm.

gene_pairs.status_label: Part of a multi-gene CPIC dosing guideline
gene_pairs.scope_note: The warfarin guideline considers multiple genes and clinical information; CYP4F2 is not included in the prototype marker panel.
